name: dsh-benchmark
description: Reproducible deterministic benchmark evidence for DSH tools and plugins

interface.shortDescription: Run and compare deterministic plugin benchmarks.
interface.longDescription: Runs fixed benchmark cases with bounded subprocesses, records raw exit/latency/output-hash evidence, and writes content-addressed reports and baseline comparisons.
interface.defaultPrompt: Inspect this benchmark manifest, run its fixed cases, and compare the content-addressed report with the declared baseline.
